name: oro-design-system
description: Oro design system — @oro/tokens + @oro/ui, documented with Storybook (react-native-web).

scripts.test:interactions: start-server-and-test 'http-server apps/storybook/storybook-static -p 6006 -s' http://127.0.0.1:6006/index.json 'pnpm --filter @oro/storybook exec test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006'
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm -e CI=true -e npm_config_store_dir=/tmp/pnpm-store -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble bash -lc 'corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright test --update-snapshots' ; CI=true pnpm install
